definitions.explanation: The practice of maintaining cleanliness and health, or the conditions and standards that promote good health and prevent disease.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{洗|あら}うのは{衛生|えいせい}の{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Washing your hands is the basis of hygiene.

examples.japanese: この{飲食店|いんしょくてん}は{衛生|えいせい}{管理|かんり}が{徹底|てってい}している。
examples.english: This restaurant has thorough hygiene management.

examples.japanese: {途上国|とじょうこく}では、{衛生|えいせい}{環境|かんきょう}の{改善|かいぜん}が{感染症|かんせんしょう}の{予防|よぼう}に{大|おお}きく{貢献|こうけん}する。
examples.english: In developing countries, improving sanitation conditions greatly contributes to preventing infectious diseases.

notes:
USAGE:
A practical, everyday word used in food service, healthcare, public health, and daily life. Not to be confused with the homophone {衛星|えいせい} (satellite).

COMPOUNDS:
- {衛生|えいせい}{管理|かんり}: hygiene management
- {衛生|えいせい}{的|てき}: hygienic, sanitary
- {衛生|えいせい}{状態|じょうたい}: sanitary conditions
- {公衆|こうしゅう}{衛生|えいせい}: public health/hygiene
- {食品|しょくひん}{衛生|えいせい}: food hygiene
- {衛生|えいせい}{士|し}: hygienist
